newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan bans Japan contracts in islands row.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan bans Japan contracts in islands row.

text.p: Taiwan's provincial assembly voted on Tuesday to exclude Japanese firms from local contracts to protest Japan's assertion of sovereignty over a chain of East China Sea islands, an official said.
In a resolution, the assembly also called on the province to boycott all Japanese goods and immediately halt all purchasing contracts, the assembly official said by telephone.

The resolution is binding on all contracts with Taiwan's provincial government, but does not affect those with the central Republic of China government. Both have extensive contacts with Japanese firms.
The sanctions would stand until a mounting dispute over the islands is resolved, the official said.

The island's biggest county, Taipei County, passed a similar resolution last week excluding Japanese firms from bidding for any county construction projects and calling for a boycott of Japanese goods.
